statements.t: We measure revenue based on the amount of consideration we expect to be entitled to in exchange for products or services.

For revenue recognized on sales to distributors and on royalties, the amount of consideration we expect to be entitled to receive is based on estimates that require assumptions and judgments relating to trends in recent and historical activity and, for usage-based royalties where licensee reports are not yet available, estimates of licensee sales or usage.

We assign this revenue first to a specific end market using historical and anticipated usage of the specific products, if possible, and allocate the remainder to the end markets based on either historical usage for each product family or industry application data for certain product types.
We expect AI-related revenue to grow over the next few years based on the growing pipeline of AI-related design wins in a diverse set of applications across both of our end market groups.
We expect research and development expense to increase in the future, but to decline as a percentage of revenue.
We expect selling, general, and administrative expense to increase in the future, but to decline as a percentage of revenue.

Other companies, including companies in our industry, may calculate similarly-titled non-GAAP financial measures differently or may use other measures to evaluate their performance, all of which could reduce the usefulness of Adjusted EBITDA as a tool for comparison.

Our presentation of Adjusted EBITDA should not be construed as an inference that our future results will be unaffected by these expenses or any unusual or non-recurring items, as in the future we may incur expenses similar to the adjustments in this presentation.

We may also seek to obtain equity or additional debt financing if we experience downturns or cyclical fluctuations in our business that are more severe or longer than we anticipated when determining our current working capital needs.
Inventories as of October 3, 2026 increased by $31.4 million, or 35%, compared to January 3, 2026 as we build inventory to meet expected continued demand growth.

estimates.name: Acquisition Accounting
estimates.t: The fair value of the consideration the Company pays in an acquisition is allocated to tangible assets and identifiable intangible assets, liabilities assumed, and goodwill.

statements.t: Strong bookings, backlog and design wins support our fourth-quarter revenue outlook of approximately $335 million and reinforce our confidence in growth into 2027 and beyond.

Consequently, the Company is unable to calculate the most directly comparable GAAP measure to non-GAAP gross margin percentage, non-GAAP total operating expenses, non-GAAP income tax rate, non-GAAP EPS, and non-GAAP net income for the Company’s fourth quarter of 2026 guidance.
Lattice Semiconductor will review the Company's financial results for the fiscal third quarter 2026 , and business outlook on Monday, November 2, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.
The Company's financial guidance will be limited to the comments on its public quarterly earnings call and the public business outlook statements contained in this press release.

risks.t: global economic conditions which may affect customer demand
the cyclical nature of the semiconductor industry including fluctuating customer and distributor purchasing patterns, inventory levels, and order timing
competitive actions including competition from customers’ internal development efforts and open-source or other alternative firmware and software solutions
the risk of impairment of the goodwill and acquired intangible assets recorded in connection with the AMI acquisition
our dependence on third-party foundry, assembly and test providers and our ability to obtain sufficient manufacturing capacity
the retention of key employees of the acquired business
the rapid pace of technological change and our ability to develop and introduce new products on schedule
risks relating to intellectual property and litigation
delays, defects or other difficulties in developing, releasing, updating or supporting our firmware and software products
other significant risks and uncertainties that are beyond our ability to predict or control
